messages:
leena (evals): Flagging a reproducible regression on maru-v2-q3 for mixed CJK+Persian subtitle tests. chrF down ~0.10 on focused slice. Not seen on fp16 baseline.
omar (quant): what export flags did q3 use?
leena (evals): q3 included vocab_prune + token_shrink + nfkc_normalize. Short repro below (src -> ref -> fp16 -> q3):
``
src: "第3章 - (قلا 3) 😀"
ref: "第3章 - (قلا 3) 😀"
maru-v2-fp16: "第3章 - (قلا 3) 😀"
maru-v2-q3: "第 3 章 ‏-(قلا 3) 😀"
```
leena (evals): token dump shows a space inserted inside the CJK cluster and an RLM (‏) prepended to the Persian token in the q3 variant.
song (eng-ml): runtime canary logs show `kvcache: offset_mismatch expected=40 got=36 seq=8` for the failing request id. Also a single `decoder: zero_token_emitted` event.
omar (quant): likely the vocab_prune remap or token_shrink remapping is shifting ids, and nfkc may reorder punctuation triggering bidi heuristics. Immediate plan: reproduce locally with prune/shrink toggled and produce token_id->char mapping diffs. I'll run `tools/verify_remap.py --model maru-v2 --export q3 --cases prune,shrink,nfkc`.
yuri (serving): I'll pause q3 routing in eu-central and ap-northeast and route to fp16 for new requests. Also enabling extra token->kv debug logging in canary for 12h.
ci-bot: EXPORT maru-v2 -> q3 (prune_vocab=true, token_shrink=true, nfkc=true) SUCCESS at 3155555560
leena (evals): I'll run a focused subtitle subset (CJK chapter headers + Persian inline + emoji) and post chrF / BLEU deltas for each bisect variant.
omar (quant): if remap is root cause we can hotfix by reverting prune step in q3 builds while we correct table generation. ETA for quick patch ~3h.
yuri (serving): rollback staged if needed. For now paused.
leena (evals): TL;DR: maru-v2-q3 introduces space and RLM around CJK+Persian boundary; kv offset mismatches observed; q3 paused. Actions: remap verification (omar), focused eval slice (leena), extra kv debug (yuri).
